one_line: Satavahana queen of the Naneghat pass, proclaiming royal sacrifice and patronage in stone.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, poised and athletic rather than fragile, with the bearing of a ritual leader used to processions and courtly ceremony.
appearance.face: Oval face with soft jawline, medium-brown Deccan complexion, large almond-shaped eyes with a steady, thoughtful gaze, straight medium-length nose, defined brows, a small tilak of red pigment at the centre of her forehead, and a calm, composed default expression that often edges into a slight, knowing half-smile when she addresses priests or traders.
appearance.hair: Long black hair oiled smooth and parted in the middle, gathered into a high, neatly wound bun at the back of the crown; a slender gold circlet with a small central lotus motif sits low on the forehead, and two thin side-locks frame her cheeks, tucked behind the ears and reaching just below the jawline.
appearance.costume: She wears an early Deccan royal sari-style outfit: a deep-red cotton sari with a narrow gold-woven border, wrapped in a lower-garment style around the waist and reaching to the ankles, pleated slightly at the front for ease of movement; over this, a separate mustard-gold upper cloth (uttariya) drapes modestly across her torso and over both shoulders, covering her chest fully and hanging to mid-thigh in front and back; the fabric is plain but edged with a thin dark-green stripe; her waist is cinched with a flat gold girdle made of linked rectangular plaques; jewellery includes medium-sized circular gold earrings, a simple multi-strand gold bead necklace resting just above the upper cloth, two slim bangles on each wrist, and an armlet on her right upper arm shaped as a subtle coiled vine; she wears plain brown leather sandals with toe loops, practical for stone paths in the pass.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript secured with a red cord, held in her left hand or tucked at her waist, symbolizing the Naneghat inscription and her formal recording of sacrifices and gifts, often accompanied by a simple shallow offering bowl of metal at her side.

ref_desc: Queen Naganika is a medium-brown oval-faced woman in her early 30s with long black hair in a high bun under a thin gold circlet, wearing a deep-red sari with gold border, mustard-gold upper cloth, simple gold jewellery, leather sandals, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Queen Naganika, a Satavahana-era Deccan queen: she is in her early 30s, medium height, medium-brown complexion, with an oval face, large almond eyes, defined brows, and a calm thoughtful expression with a small red tilak on her forehead; her long black hair is oiled smooth, parted in the middle and gathered into a high neat bun at the back of the crown, with two thin side-locks framing her cheeks, and she wears a slender gold circlet with a small central lotus motif low across her forehead; her outfit is an early Deccan royal ensemble consisting of a deep-red cotton sari with a narrow gold-woven border wrapped as a lower garment around her waist down to her ankles, slightly pleated at the front, and a separate mustard-gold upper cloth draped modestly over her torso and both shoulders, covering her chest fully and hanging to mid-thigh, edged with a thin dark-green stripe; a flat gold girdle made of linked rectangular plaques sits at her waist; jewellery includes medium circular gold earrings, a short multi-strand gold bead necklace above the upper cloth, two slim gold bangles on each wrist, and a delicate vine-shaped armlet on her right upper arm; she wears simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; in her left hand she holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord, symbolizing her inscription, and beside her or in her other hand is a plain metal offering bowl, all rendered in rich but historically grounded colours of deep red, mustard gold, dark green, warm gold, and natural browns, with clean anime lines so the design can be consistently redrawn from multiple angles.
